hold_text: PHONE-NO-FLAG-SECURE. Removes the screenshot block from the phone executor entirely: no FLAG_SECURE on the window or the Setup dialog, and the heartbeat drops secure/secure_why/secure_min (server allowlist trimmed; older builds' fields are dropped, not stored). Capture.credentialScreen stays only as the gate on the app's own self-captures uploaded to the VM. No click, claim, navigation or order path change. Needs ONE APK install (the APK from the merge commit). Manager merges on the operator's screenshot result. Revert: git revert.
why: Operator 2026-11-12 ~09:12Z: "if this version doesn't fix the screenshot issue, then we're getting rid of that feature entirely ... There is no blocking of screenshots. That's basically a gate that I didn't ask for".
